representations.name: Stable affine Macaulay word in q
representations.new_information: Stores every canonical digit as an affine function of q together with the exact threshold at which digit ordering and remainder legality stabilize.
representations.first_test: Reconstruct the proposed K4,r9 rank-seven x/y words and reject at the first failed binomial sum, digit order, or threshold.

representations.name: Pascal-aligned paired words
representations.new_information: Aligns the x and y canonical words rank by rank so their leading shifts cancel by Pascal identities before polynomial expansion.
representations.first_test: Derive gamma7 for K4,r9 twice, once from direct shadows and once by aligned Pascal cancellation.

representations.name: Fixed-(k,r) canonical transducer
representations.new_information: Represents one rank step as a transition on stable affine digit offsets and the current surplus polynomial for fixed k,r.
representations.first_test: Enumerate fixed k,r seeds with exact dyadic residues and compare predicted next words with direct Macaulay reconstruction.

representations.name: First recovery-rank profile
representations.new_information: Records the first rank with nonnegative surplus, all preceding signs, and the canonical-stability threshold as functions of fixed k,r.
representations.first_test: Search small fixed k,r families for profiles that exceed rank seven or fail to stabilize.

representations.name: Exact dyadic residue orbit
representations.new_information: Keeps h=112*2^(j-1), q integrality, legal inequalities, and the fixed-(k,r) residue class instead of treating q as an arbitrary integer.
representations.first_test: For every candidate fixed k,r recurrence, determine the exact infinite set of j realizing integral legal q.

representations.name: Canonical q-threshold ledger
representations.new_information: Separates the dyadic start threshold, sign thresholds, and lower-digit canonical thresholds, preventing eventual formulas from being used too early.
representations.first_test: Verify the maximum threshold for every displayed K4,r9 rank-seven digit and compare it with q at odd j=33.

representations.name: Binomial-basis surplus polynomial
representations.new_information: Expands gamma_m in a translated binomial or ordinary polynomial basis where eventual sign follows from exact roots or nonnegative coefficients.
representations.first_test: Factor the proposed gamma7 quadratic and certify positivity on the legal q progression without floating-point roots.

representations.name: Lower-digit constant recurrence ledger
representations.new_information: Tracks the rapidly growing rank-one constants and verifies when they remain below the preceding affine digit.
representations.first_test: Check 647801944<q-20 and 229094347523<q-17 at the claimed first stable member, then propagate under q_(j+2)=4q_j-4.

representations.name: Borrow-wall recovery tree
representations.new_information: Branches on the first rank where a canonical constant violates ordering, a borrow occurs, or the surplus becomes nonnegative.
representations.first_test: Route the K4,r9 family and nearby fixed-(k,r) families through exact branches with no unlabelled terminal leaf.

representations.name: Adaptive seed composition object
representations.new_information: Packages recovery rank, actual dyadic legality, surplus margin, and suffix-persistence hypotheses for later composition to rank 42.
representations.first_test: Instantiate it on K4,r9 rank seven and list every missing condition preventing public composition.
